title: Georeferenced survey line (SYNTHETIC navigation)
description: A contiguous frame sequence paired with a SYNTHETIC navigation track so that geolocation, positional uncertainty, spatial deduplication and the map can be demonstrated. The coordinates describe a fictional survey line and are NOT the true positions of these objects.
short_description: Geolocation + map demo. Navigation track is SYNTHETIC.
attribution: Imagery: Pessanha Santos, N. & Moura, R. (2024), 'Side-scan sonar imaging data of underwater vehicles for mine detection', Data in Brief 53:110132. figshare DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.24574879. Licensed CC BY 4.0.
synthetic_navigation_warning: Coordinates produced from this scenario are fictional. They demonstrate the geolocation computation, not real object positions.
